description: Architecture-only repository validation tooling and design for deterministic transistor-level analogue circuit studies: operating points, small-signal and transient response, oscillator and phase-locked-loop jitter bounds, brown-out reset hysteresis, ageing margins, statistical Monte Carlo mismatch yield bounds and dual-simulator consensus. No SPICE study runner, Monte Carlo mismatch harness, dual-simulator comparator or qualified record schema is released.
title: Circuit Analog
